products.reviewNote: Yearly plan of Pepline Pro: reconstitution calculator, dose journal, schedules and reminders, weight log, CSV export. 7-day free trial. Pepline converts units for the dose the user's prescriber set; it never recommends a dose.
Monthly plan of the same Pepline Pro entitlement as the yearly subscription. No free trial.
